summary: Resource destructor. First runs F_9PointerArrayCleanup(this) to clear the object's pointer-array region, then walks the singly-linked list starting at this+0x24. For each node it follows the next link, and when the per-node flag byte is set it frees the node's data pointer (freeing the data's own sub-pointer first when present), then frees the node itself. Finally zeroes the list head fields at 0x24, 0x28, 0x2C, 0x30 and returns 0.

operations.description: Run F_9PointerArrayCleanup(this) to clear the pointer array region.
Read the first list node from this+0x24 as the iteration seed.
Walk the singly-linked list, following the next pointer of each node until null.
Per-node: only perform data cleanup when the flag byte in the node is non-zero.
Per-node: skip data cleanup when the node's data pointer is null.
Per-node: free the data's sub-pointer only when it is non-null.
Free the sub-pointer, then the data pointer, then the node itself via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Zero the list head fields at this+0x24, this+0x28, this+0x2C and this+0x30.
Invoked by SubObjectDestructorChain, FrontendScreenLoadingDisplayHandler and sub_4FE7C0.
